vo.en: Your arm is about to float.

visual.description: A close up of a male hand slowly rising against a dark, moody background with particles.

vo.en: Quick, find a wall. Stand sideways and press the back of your hand against it.

visual.description: A man in a t-shirt standing next to a concrete wall prepared to push his arm against it.

vo.en: Push as hard as you can. Seriously, use all your strength and don't stop.

visual.description: A macro shot of a male forearm showing muscle tension and veins under pressure.

vo.en: But here is the creepy part. Your brain is about to lose control.

visual.description: An abstract 3D model of a brain flashing with digital glitch effects and neural nodes.

vo.en: Keep pushing. Five, four, three, two, one. Now step away and relax your muscles.

visual.description: An elegant hourglass with golden sand falling rapidly through the glass.

vo.en: Your arm is rising by itself. This is a literal motor glitch called the Kohnstamm effect.

visual.description: A man's arm lifting up involuntarily in slow motion as if pulled by an invisible string.

vo.en: Subscribe for tomorrow's brain test and comment YES if it worked, which is exactly why

visual.description: A close up of a man's thumb tapping the notification bell on a smartphone.
